short: ReFIT-KF + HMM click (M06) and ccpm/bitrate protocol (M12) are standard for 2017; 1.4-4.2x record gains are cross-study and the HMM is never isolated; later decoders reach 110 chars/min.
position: The paper [@pandarinath2017high] changes the decoder (M06), a ReFIT Kalman cursor with an HMM click, and the evaluation (M12), peak ccpm plus achieved grid bitrate without word completion. Both are standard for its time: its Table 1 lists 2 prior intracortical typing studies, both with an LDA classifier, and the paper adapts the ReFIT-KF and HMM from earlier work; the same pairing ran in prior monkey typing [@nuyujukian2017nonhuman]. The record holds as performance, not as component evidence: each 1.4-4.2x gain compares across studies, tasks and partly the same participants (Table 1), and no experiment isolates the HMM click. Today, [later] decoders reach 62-78 words per minute from attempted speech and 110 characters per minute from attempted typing [@willett2023high; @metzger2023high; @jude2026bimanual].
